verses.en: Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens, that thou wouldest come down, that the mountains might flow down at thy presence,
verses.pt: Ah, se tu rompesses os céus, e descesses, os montes se tremeriam de diante de tua presença,
verses.en_web: Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence.
verses.en_bbe: O let the heavens be broken open and come down, so that the mountains may be shaking before you,

verses.en: As when the melting fire burneth, the fire causeth the waters to boil, to make thy name known to thine adversaries, that the nations may tremble at thy presence!
verses.pt: Tal como o fogo acende a madeira, e o fogo faz ferver as águas; para assim fazeres notório o teu nome a teus adversários, de modo que as nações tremessem de tua presença!
verses.en_web: As when fire kindles the brushwood, and the fire causes the water to boil; Make your name known to your adversaries, that the nations may tremble at your presence!
verses.en_bbe: As when fire puts the brushwood in flames, or as when water is boiling from the heat of the fire: to make your name feared by your haters, so that the nations may be shaking before you;

verses.en: When thou didst terrible things which we looked not for, thou camest down, the mountains flowed down at thy presence.
verses.pt: Como quando fazias coisas temíveis, as quais nunca esperávamos; quando tu descias, e os montes se tremiam diante de tua presença.
verses.en_web: When you did awesome things which we didn’t look for, you came down, and the mountains quaked at your presence.
verses.en_bbe: While you do acts of power for which we are not looking, and which have not come to the ears of men in the past.

verses.en: For since the beginning of the world men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen, O God, beside thee, what he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him.
verses.pt: Nem desde os tempos antigos se ouviu, nem com os ouvidos se percebeu, nem olho viu outro Deus além de ti, que age em favor daquele que nele espera.
verses.en_web: For from of old men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, nor has the eye seen a God besides you, who works for him who waits for him.
verses.en_bbe: The ear has not had news of, or the eye seen, ... any God but you, working for the man who is waiting for him.

verses.en: Thou meetest him that rejoiceth and worketh righteousness, those that remember thee in thy ways: behold, thou art wroth; for we have sinned: in those is continuance, and we shall be saved.
verses.pt: Tu foste ao encontro do alegre, e do que pratica justiça, e aos que se lembram de ti em teus caminhos. Eis que te enfureceste porque pecamos por muito tempo. Seremos salvos?
verses.en_web: You meet him who rejoices and does righteousness, those who remember you in your ways. Behold, you were angry, and we sinned. We have been in sin for a long time. Shall we be saved?
verses.en_bbe: Will you not have mercy on him who takes pleasure in doing righteousness, even on those who keep in mind your ways? Truly you were angry, and we went on doing evil, and sinning against you in the past.

verses.en: But we are all as an unclean thing, and all our righteousnesses are as filthy rags; and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.
verses.pt: Porém todos nós somos como um imundo, e todas as nossas justiças são como roupas contaminadas; e todos nós caímos como uma folha, e nossas culpas nos levam como o vento.
verses.en_web: For we have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteousness is like a polluted garment. We all fade like a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, take us away.
verses.en_bbe: For we have all become like an unclean person, and all our good acts are like a dirty robe: and we have all become old like a dead leaf, and our sins, like the wind, take us away.

verses.en: And there is none that calleth upon thy name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee: for thou hast hid thy face from us, and hast consumed us, because of our iniquities.
verses.pt: E ninguém há que invoque a teu nome, que se desperte para se apegar a ti; pois tu escondeste teu rosto de nós, e nos consumiste por nossas perversidades.
verses.en_web: There is no one who calls on your name, who stirs himself up to take hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us, and have consumed us by means of our iniquities.
verses.en_bbe: And there is no one who makes prayer to your name, or who is moved to keep true to you: for your face is veiled from us, and you have given us into the power of our sins.

verses.en: But now, O LORD, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.
verses.pt: Porém agora, SENHOR, tu és nosso Pai; nós somos barro, e tu és nosso oleiro; e todos nós somos obra de tuas mãos.
verses.en_web: But now, Yahweh, you are our Father. We are the clay, and you our potter. We all are the work of your hand.
verses.en_bbe: But now, O Lord, you are our father; we are the earth, and you are our maker; and we are all the work of your hand.

verses.en: Be not wroth very sore, O LORD, neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, see, we beseech thee, we are all thy people.
verses.pt: Não te enfureças tanto, SENHOR, nem te lembres da nossa perversidade para sempre; vê, olha agora, que todos nós somos teu povo.
verses.en_web: Don’t be furious, Yahweh, and don’t remember iniquity forever. Look and see, we beg you, we are all your people.
verses.en_bbe: Be not very angry, O Lord, and do not keep our sins in mind for ever: give ear to our prayer, for we are all your people.

verses.en: Thy holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
verses.pt: Tuas santas cidades se tornaram um deserto; Sião se tornou um deserto; Jerusalém está assolada.
verses.en_web: Your holy cities have become a wilderness. Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
verses.en_bbe: Your holy towns have become a waste, Zion has become a waste, Jerusalem is a mass of broken walls.

verses.en: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised thee, is burned up with fire: and all our pleasant things are laid waste.
verses.pt: Nossa santa e nossa gloriosa casa, em que nossos pais te louvavam, foi queimada a fogo; e todas as coisas com que nos agradávamos se tornaram ruínas.
verses.en_web: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised you, is burned with fire; and all our pleasant places are laid waste.
verses.en_bbe: Our holy and beautiful house, where our fathers gave praise to you, is burned with fire; and all the things of our desire have come to destruction.

verses.en: Wilt thou refrain thyself for these things, O LORD? wilt thou hold thy peace, and afflict us very sore?
verses.pt: Será que continuarás a te conter sobre estas coisas, SENHOR? Continuarás quieto, e nos oprimindo tanto?
verses.en_web: Will you hold yourself back for these things, Yahweh? Will you keep silent, and punish us very severely?
verses.en_bbe: In view of all this, will you still do nothing, O Lord? will you keep quiet, and go on increasing our punishment?
